integrity: The exact finite calculations are reproduced by the included standalone verifier; the higher-dimensional extension is symbolic. Literature comparisons distinguish the finite-field boundary from the infinite-field theorem and from nonsingular-space classifications.
scientific_limitations: Minimal ambient dimension is proved only over the binary field.
No classification of all binary dimension-three counterexamples is claimed.
No odd-characteristic analogue or derivation-space realization is claimed.
The finite-field nonsingular-three-space comparison was inspected through its public reproducibility record; differently phrased all-singular examples remain a residual literature risk.
title: A sharp binary failure of local-to-global invertibility for algebraic reflexive hulls
